instruction.german: Read the conversation in Figure it out, then complete the rules in the grammar box with these words.

parts:
Figure it out

A: If I don’t have breakfast, I feel tired all day.

B: Me too! I feel better when I eat some fruit in the morning. You should eat fruit.

A: I’m allergic to some fruit. I feel very ill if I eat strawberries.


Grammar | Zero conditional (if / when …)

• We use the zero conditional to talk about 1 or things that are always true.

The zero conditional has two clauses:

Condition clause Result clause

If I don’t have breakfast, I feel tired all day.

If + present simple, 2

• If can go at the 3 of the sentence or in the middle.

• We can also use 4 instead of if. It is more common in the middle of the sentence.
